author: the analysis author (velvt-app PR-7)
description: Ratings drawn from the H2 model itself: proportional odds on the four standardized features with known slopes (work_anchor_share 0.8, switch-aways per covered hour -0.3, log longest run share 0.3, offer delivered -0.2) and a person offset (SD 0.7). At the planned n (about 220 primary ratings from 15 people), H1 must pass in nearly every replicate, and the held-out AUROC must sit clearly above 0.5.
